scope: Selected Isaac Lab simulation rollouts, edited for a public portfolio. Individual clips do not establish a success rate or physical-robot validation.

sources.context: Partial iteration-7600 policy, seed 3042, four preselected environments. Initial env0 and env2 tip successfully; env1 fails a support check; env3 times out without a stable tip. This visual sample is not a qualification evaluation.

Final frozen seed42 PPO policy. The final filmed env0 batch descends toward a 24 cm target. The recorded 17 cm successful episodes are not filmed. Both independent assessments failed the criterion of at least 80 percent whole-episode success in every populated motion/depth cell.

derivation.video: libx264 CRF 18, slow, yuv420p, faststart, CPU threads 2

clips.selection: Foreground env0, first three successful tipping episodes and their resets. Crop removes the surrounding collage and telemetry bars; no interpolation or motion synthesis.

Final filmed batch, descent and initial low hold. Foreground robot retained; source header and bottom legend cropped. Target and actual coordinate axes remain. This is an excerpt, not a complete episode.
Foreground env3, entire unsuccessful initial episode through the source's 15-second endpoint. No stable tip before timeout. Surrounding collage and telemetry bars cropped.
